scope: Current BackgroundMusic.ts transpiled with deterministic Cocos 3.8.8 play/pause/stop/ENDED/currentTime semantics; not browser/TapTap playback

cases.name: No combat never produces an aftermath; short combat below .7s is ignored
Qualified battle waits four peaceful seconds, then starts a non-looping aftermath at zero
Authoritative unsettled engagement holds combat even after the four-second timer
Afterscore tail returns once to exploration at its opening; peaceful time does not replay it
Actual ENDED callback also recovers if the main loop missed the normal tail threshold
A renewed fight interrupts aftermath immediately and retains at most two audible modes
Muting an active aftermath pauses it and resumes the same position without stop/seek/restart
Background and allowed=false pause all three; returning to the same after does not seek
Fight ending while muted produces no delayed aftermath on unmute
Area change, loading and death interruptions clear battle qualification without playing an ending
Area reset cancels an already active aftermath rather than resuming it in a new area
Missing optional aftermath falls back without polling or delayed replay; explicit retry recovers
